extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: 1990s minivan (MPV, family van), approx. 4.6 x 1.9 x 1.9 m (L x W x H), wheel diameter 0.66 m
extras.notes: generic, brand-free rounded 1990s 'jelly bean' minivan: one-box shape, steeply raked windscreen flowing into the bonnet, body-colour bumpers with grey rub strips, wide grey side cladding, clear-glass headlights, tall slim tail lights; no moving doors; front faces -Y; 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); hollow cabin with transparent windows and three seat rows; blank number plates, no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
